excerpt: Mapilak Line 2 is a registered banana variety, also sold or known as Mapilak 2 or NSIC Bn 02. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2021 as NSIC 2021 Bn 02. Institute of Plant Breeding bred it. Its record notes a yield of 13 kg/tree/year, 7 hands/bunch, 1.9kg/hand.

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Mapilak 2 or NSIC Bn 02, this is the same banana. The facts below come from the NSIC registry kept by the Bureau of Plant Industry, with notes from its seller and farm sources. blocks.text: When does it bear, and how much?

A registered tree variety is described from its mother tree, not from trial plots. Its record notes a yield of 13 kg/tree/year, 7 hands/bunch, 1.9kg/hand. A grafted or marcotted tree bears years sooner than one grown from seed, and its yield climbs as the tree grows.

anee.io keeps the records of each block of trees, from fertilizer to harvest, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside them.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
The registry gives no pest or disease ratings for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit banana fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [Banana aphid](/pests/banana-aphid), [Banana bunchy top](/diseases/banana-bunchy-top), [Banana weevil](/pests/banana-weevil), [black sigatoka](/diseases/black-sigatoka). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
A fruit of Mapilak Line 2 weighs about 116.84 grams, and its shape is slightly curve to straight. The flesh is yellow orange and firm.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Harvest:** Flowers about 352 days and is harvested about 452 days after planting.
**Yield:** About 13 kg per plant a year, 7 hands per bunch, about 1.9 kg per hand.
**Fruit:** Fingers about 14 cm, 117 g, sweet (27 Brix), easy to peel, about 71 percent edible.
**Where:** Laguna, Batangas, Cavite, Quirino, Isabela, Davao City.
Resistant to bunchy top virus and its aphid vector.
Shorter plant, early shooting and harvest.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: the improved Mapilak line, tested in Laguna, Batangas, Cavite, Quirino, Isabela and Davao City. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant Mapilak Line 2 banana

Lakatan and latundan sell fresh, saba goes to cooking and banana cue, and Cavendish goes to export. Fusarium wilt and bunchy top end many farms, so plant clean tissue cultured plantlets, and a tolerant selection where wilt is known. A registered tree variety is a selection from one proven mother tree, and only grafted, budded or marcotted plants carry its traits. A seedling grown from its seed can turn out quite different. So buy from a nursery accredited by the Bureau of Plant Industry, and ask which mother tree the scions came from. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for banana](/land-preparation/banana-land-preparation).

items: Buy grafted or budded plants from an accredited nursery, with the variety name on the tag.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Plant a few trees first if the variety is new to your area, before you fill the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is Mapilak 2 the same as Mapilak Line 2?
items.a: Yes. Mapilak 2 is another name for Mapilak Line 2, registered as NSIC 2021 Bn 02. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
The record shows a recorded yield of 13 kg/tree/year, 7 hands/bunch, 1.9kg/hand. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy planting material of Mapilak Line 2?
items.a: Buy grafted, budded or marcotted trees from a nursery accredited by the Bureau of Plant Industry, so you get the true variety. Ask your provincial agriculture office for the nearest one.
